reason: Alert-TP: The sink expression at line 35 outputs user input from request.getParameter() into HTML. While param.replace("\"", """) performs partial sanitization, it only escapes double-quotes—not angle brackets (<, >). An attacker can inject <script> tags that bypass this incomplete sanitization, making the resolved sink value attacker-controlled.

evidence.note: User input flows from request.getParameter() -> param -> bar -> HTML output without complete sanitization against script injection
